high_level_description: This image is a triptych showing the Shanghai Formula One Grand Prix from 2008, 2014, and 2024. Each panel captures the race track and surrounding environment at different times. Setting: The scene is set at the Shanghai International Circuit, with modern buildings and a large crowd of spectators in the background. Objects: The track is clearly visible with several Formula One cars racing. The grandstand on the right side is packed with fans, and there are banners and advertisements for "Sinopec" prominently displayed above the track.
